items.stem: 【听力·短对话】听辨要点：女：Have you finished the book I lent you last week? 男：Not yet. I've only read half of it because I've had too much homework to do. 问题：What do we learn about the man? A. He has returned the book. B. He has finished reading the whole book. C. He has read half of the book. D. He has no homework to do.
items.solution: 听辨关键句："I've only read half of it"。该句直接表明男士仅读了一半书本，对应选项 C。其它选项与原文相反或不符。
options: A. He has returned the book.
B. He has finished reading the whole book.
C. He has read half of the book.
D. He has no homework to do.

items.stem: 【听力·短对话】听辨要点：女：When will the meeting begin? 男：It was supposed to start at 9, but the manager called to say he'd be twenty minutes late. 问题：When will the meeting begin? A. At 8:40. B. At 9:00. C. At 9:20. D. At 9:40.
items.solution: 原计划 9:00 开始，经理迟到 20 分钟，即 9:20 开始。听力细节题关键是数字计算，故选 C。

items.stem: 【听力·短对话·语调辨义】听辨要点：男：So you really think we should tell her the truth?（升调）女：Of course. Honesty is the best policy, after all. 问题：What does the woman mean? A. She disagrees with telling the truth. B. She thinks honesty is sometimes wrong. C. She strongly agrees with telling the truth. D. She has no idea to pay.
items.solution: 男士用升调确认，女士回答"Of course"加强语气，并补充"Honesty is the best policy"，表赞同。语调辨义与语义结合，选 C。
options: A. She disagrees with telling the truth.
B. She thinks honesty is sometimes wrong.
C. She strongly agrees with telling the truth.
D. She has no idea to pay.

items.stem: 【听力·长对话】听辨要点：男：I heard you went on a trip to Zhangjiajie last month. 女：Yes, it was wonderful. The mountains were covered in mist, and we stayed in a small inn near the national park. 男：Sounds great. How long did you stay? 女：Just four days, but I wish we could have stayed longer. 问题：What is the woman mainly talking about? A. A business trip. B. A holiday trip. C. A study tour. D. A family visit.
items.solution: 主旨题：女士谈到 Zhangjiajie 旅游感受和住宿，主旨为一次假期旅游，选 B。
options: A. A business trip.
B. A holiday trip.
C. A study tour.
D. A family visit.

items.stem: 【听力·独白】听辨要点：The Spring Festival Gala has been broadcast on Chinese New Year's Eve for over forty years. Every year, hundreds of millions of people sit in front of their TVs to watch it together. Although some viewers say the show has become less exciting in recent years, it remains a tradition that brings families together. 问题：What is the speaker mainly discussing? A. The history of TV. B. The Spring Festival Gala. C. Chinese New Year food. D. Modern Chinese families.
items.solution: 独白首句点出主题——Spring Festival Gala，主旨即春晚这一传统节目。选 B。
options: A. The history of TV.
B. The Spring Festival Gala.
C. Chinese New Year food.
D. Modern Chinese families.

items.stem:
【阅读理解A·应用文】
NOTICE
Volunteer English Tutors Needed
The Community Library is looking for English tutors to help children aged 8 to 12 on Saturday mornings from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m. Tutors should be patient, friendly and able to speak clear English. Each tutor will work with a small group of four to six children. A short training session will be provided on the first Saturday. If you are interested, please contact Ms. Liu at liu@library.org before Friday, October 18.
问题：Who is the notice intended for? A. Parents of children aged 8 to 12. B. English teachers from local schools. C. People who want to teach English to children for free. D. Children who want to improve their English.
items.solution: 主旨题：通告标题与正文共同表明，社区图书馆招募"Volunteer English Tutors"（志愿）免费辅导 8-12 岁儿童，对应 C。其它选项混淆目标人群。
options: A. Parents of children aged 8 to 12.
B. English teachers from local schools.
C. People who want to teach English to children for free.
D. Children who want to improve their English.

items.stem: 【阅读理解A·应用文·续】根据上文通告，问题：How many children will each tutor work with at most? A. Four. B. Five. C. Six. D. Eight.
items.solution: 细节题：通告中"work with a small group of four to six children"，最多 6 人，选 C。
options: A. Four.
B. Five.
C. Six.
D. Eight.

items.stem:
【阅读理解B·记叙文】
When I was ten, my grandfather gave me a small wooden boat he had carved by hand. "Every great journey starts with a single push," he told me, smiling. I kept the boat on my desk for years and, although I never sailed it, it always reminded me of him. After he passed away, I finally placed the boat on a shelf where I could see it every day. Now, whenever I face a difficult choice, I remember his words and find the courage to move forward.
问题：Why did the writer keep the boat on his desk? A. He wanted to learn to sail. B. He used it as a pencil holder. C. It reminded him of his grandfather. D. It was a gift from his friend.
items.solution: 细节题：文中"it always reminded me of him"即祖父，对应 C。
options: A. He wanted to learn to sail.
B. He used it as a pencil holder.
C. It reminded him of his grandfather.
D. It was a gift from his friend.

items.stem: 【阅读理解B·记叙文·续】根据上文短文，问题：What can we infer about the writer's grandfather? A. He was a sailor by profession. B. He cared about the writer and wanted to encourage him. C. He disliked carving wooden objects. D. He had travelled all over the world.
items.solution: 推断题：祖父亲自手刻木船并赠言鼓励，可推断他关爱作者并希望鼓励他成长，故选 B。
options: A. He was a sailor by profession.
B. He cared about the writer and wanted to encourage him.
C. He disliked carving wooden objects.
D. He had travelled all over the world.

items.stem:
【阅读理解C·说明文】
The Amazon rainforest, often called "the lungs of the Earth", produces roughly 6 percent of the world's oxygen and stores huge amounts of carbon. However, in recent decades, large areas have been cleared for farming and cattle raising. Scientists warn that if the current rate of deforestation continues, the rainforest could turn into a dry savanna by the end of this century, which would release enormous amounts of carbon dioxide and speed up global warming.
问题：What is the main idea of the passage? A. Why the Amazon is called "the lungs of the Earth". B. How oxygen is produced in the forest. C. The danger the Amazon rainforest is facing. D. How to plant trees in the rainforest.
items.solution: 主旨题：首段介绍亚马逊雨林作用，次段重点讲砍伐带来的风险，主旨为亚马逊雨林正在面临的危险，选 C。
options: A. Why the Amazon is called "the lungs of the Earth".
B. How oxygen is produced in the forest.
C. The danger the Amazon rainforest is facing.
D. How to plant trees in the rainforest.

items.stem: 【阅读理解C·说明文·续】根据上文短文，问题：What may happen if deforestation goes on? A. The rainforest will become larger. B. More oxygen will be produced. C. The rainforest may become a dry savanna. D. Global temperatures will drop sharply.
items.solution: 细节定位：第二句"the rainforest could turn into a dry savanna"，故选 C。
options: A. The rainforest will become larger.
B. More oxygen will be produced.
C. The rainforest may become a dry savanna.
D. Global temperatures will drop sharply.

items.stem: 【阅读理解C·说明文·词义猜测】根据上文短文，问题：The word "deforestation" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ________. A. planting trees in a forest B. cutting down trees in a large area C. protecting forests from fire D. counting the trees in a forest
items.solution: 词义猜测题：根据构词法 de-forest-ation（去+森林+名词后缀）及"large areas have been cleared"语境，清楚并对应 B。
options: A. planting trees in a forest
B. cutting down trees in a large area
C. protecting forests from fire
D. counting the trees in a forest

items.stem:
【阅读理解D·议论文】
Some people argue that students should be allowed to use their smartphones in class because the devices can be used as powerful learning tools. However, studies have shown that students who use phones in class often get lower grades than those who do not, mainly because they are easily distracted by social media and games. In my opinion, smartphones should be banned in class, but schools should set up special areas where students can use them for study purposes.
问题：What is the author's attitude toward using smartphones in class? A. Strongly supportive. B. Somewhat supportive. C. Neutral. D. Against, but with controlled use.
items.solution: 态度题：作者明确主张"smartphones should be banned in class"，但同时建议"special areas where students can use them for study"，故选 D：反对但可控使用。
options: A. Strongly supportive.
B. Somewhat supportive.
C. Neutral.
D. Against, but with controlled use.

items.stem: 【阅读理解D·议论文·续】根据上文短文，问题：What can be inferred from the passage? A. Smartphones always lower students' grades. B. Smartphones should be completely banned in schools. C. Smartphones can be useful if used properly. D. Social media has no influence on students.
items.solution: 推断题：作者承认手机可作学习工具，但要有使用场景限制，故选 C。
options: A. Smartphones always lower students' grades.
B. Smartphones should be completely banned in schools.
C. Smartphones can be useful if used properly.
D. Social media has no influence on students.

items.stem:
【阅读理解·图表·非连续性文本】
Survey: How do Grade 10 students spend their free time? (300 students)
- Doing homework: 32% (96)
- Playing sports: 25% (75)
- Reading books: 18% (54)
- Watching videos online: 15% (45)
- Other: 10% (30)
问题：How many students spend their free time playing sports? A. 32. B. 54. C. 75. D. 96.
items.solution: 图表细节题：直接读图，"Playing sports: 25% (75)"，故选 C。

items.stem:
【阅读理解·词义猜测】
Tom was hungry, but there was no food at home. He opened the fridge and found only a bottle of water. Then he remembered the delicious noodles at the small restaurant near his school. He took his wallet and rushed out. On the way, he met his friend Lily. "Where are you going in such a hurry?" she asked. "I'm starving! I'm going to grab a bite," Tom answered.
问题：What does the underlined phrase "grab a bite" probably mean?
items.solution: 上下文线索链：hungry（饿）→ only a bottle of water（家里没吃的）→ 想起学校附近的面馆 → 带钱包冲出门 → "I'm starving!"。由饥饿与去餐馆可知 grab a bite 意为"赶紧吃点东西"，故选 B。
options: A. Take a short rest.
B. Eat something quickly.
C. Buy a new wallet.
D. Meet an old friend.

items.stem:
【完形填空·语境选词】
Ben did not hear the alarm clock, so he got up late. He washed his face, put on his clothes and ran out of the door without breakfast. When he reached the classroom, the lesson had already begun. He said sorry to the teacher in a low voice and sat down ___, hoping the teacher would not ask why he was late.
items.solution: 语境线索：迟到、小声道歉、希望老师不追问，都表明 Ben 小心谨慎，故应"安静地"坐下，选 A。loudly（大声）、angrily（生气）、proudly（自豪）均与语境矛盾。
options: A. quietly
B. loudly
C. angrily
D. proudly

items.stem:
根据上下文线索推断词义（用中文作答）：The maths problem looked difficult at first, but after the teacher explained it step by step, it became quite simple.
句中 simple 的意思是：____
items.solution: 关键线索是转折词 but：前文 looked difficult（看起来很难），经老师逐步讲解后发生转折，simple 应与 difficult 构成反义对照，即"简单的、容易的"。

items.stem:
【阅读（10年级）·根据上下文线索或非文字信息推断词义】
Anna went to Beijing last summer. On the first day, he visited the city museum, where he saw many old things and learned about local history. The next day, he went to the beach with his new friends and enjoyed the warm sunshine. Before he left, he bought some souvenirs for his parents. He said the trip made him grow up a lot.
问题：What can we know about Anna's trip?
items.solution: 短文提及博物馆学历史、与新朋友去沙滩、给父母买纪念品，故 B 项概括最准确；其它选项均与原文细节矛盾。综合上下文线索与非文字信息推断语篇中词语的意义。
options: A. He didn't buy anything for his family.
B. He went there alone and had no friends.
C. He both learned something and had fun during the trip.
D. He only visited museums and felt bored.

items.stem:
【阅读（10年级）·根据上下文线索或非文字信息推断词义·多选】下列关于"根据上下文线索或非文字信息推断词义"的策略描述，正确的有（多选）：
在阅读一篇陌生话题的英语文章时，可以采取哪些有效策略？
items.solution: A 带着问题阅读能提高效率；C 利用篇章结构把握主旨；D 词义猜测是阅读基本策略。B 频繁查词典会打断阅读节奏，并非最佳策略。
options: A. 先读题目，再带着问题读文章
B. 遇到生词立刻查词典
C. 注意段落首尾与衔接词把握结构
D. 结合上下文和构词法猜测词义

items.stem:
【阅读（10年级）·根据上下文线索或非文字信息推断词义·填空】阅读上面短文，回答下列问题（用简短英语作答）。
1. Where did Sue go last summer?
2. What did he buy before he left?
3. How did he feel about the trip?
items.answer:
1. (He went to) Tokyo.
2. (He bought) some souvenirs (for his parents).
3. (He felt that) the trip made him grow up a lot / He felt it was great.
items.solution: 阅读细节题，结合原文作答，体现对"根据上下文线索或非文字信息推断词义"的运用。综合上下文线索与非文字信息推断语篇中词语的意义。
